annotations.title: Average price of a new manufactured home

description: The U.S. Census Bureau Manufactured Housing Survey average sales price of a new manufactured home, by month of shipment: single-section, double-section and all homes for the latest month published and the months before it. A yardstick for what filling a vacant pad with a new park-owned home costs.
